state.witness: A role-targeted policy approval must have at least one target team. Team Red is independently accepted as a target. The approver reads Red, then Red is removed before the approval commits. No fence or version check covers the removal.
state.freeze: An approved policy version has two target teams Red and Blue. The policy root has no team list. The Red and Blue target owners are independently addressable. No demonstrated mechanism orders a late target addition or removal against the version approval.
state.review: A whole policy proposal has two independently edited target teams. Alice authored a revision to the Red target. Bob authored a revision to the Blue target. The accepted rule says the reviewer cannot have authored any revision to the whole proposal. Alice only reviews the Blue target.
state.subject: For a single proposed policy revision, the source authoritatively records each editor in an independently addressable exact key consisting of proposal and editor. The source has a qualified revision fence preventing any new author from being admitted to the reviewed revision while approval is committed. Reviewer identity is Pat.
state.hash: An approval event records a hash without storing or retaining the policy audience target content or any source from which the exact targets can be reconstructed.

witness_race.instructions: In witness, can the approval commit after its only accepted target was removed?

witness_guarantee.instructions: In witness, does the earlier read prove a nonempty target set at approval?

freeze_guarantee.instructions: In freeze, does independently addressing targets establish an immutable complete target set at approval?

review_equiv.instructions: In review, does Alice reviewing only Blue satisfy the rule that the whole-proposal reviewer authored no revision?

subject_local.instructions: In subject, could an exact authoritative lookup of Pat's authorship key answer whether Pat authored a revision without enumerating all other editors?

subject_provider.instructions: In subject, does the hypothetical scenario prove the existing product source has the stated authoritative fence?

hash_complete.instructions: In hash, does the hash alone make the named audience targets recoverable?
